title: Fighte Border
description: Open-world PvP with configurable border duels, item drop protection, and competitive gameplay.
body:
# ⚔️ Fight Border – Open World 1v1 & 2v2 Duels

FightBorder is a Minecraft PvP plugin that allows players to engage in fair **1v1** and **2v2** duels directly in the open world. No arenas, no waiting, and no special duel zones required.

## ⚙️ How it works

Players can challenge each other from anywhere in the world. Once a duel is accepted, the fight begins at the players' current location.

During the duel, only participating players can damage each other. Other players cannot interfere with the fight, ensuring a fair PvP experience while allowing duels to take place naturally in the world.

After the duel ends, players are automatically restored to their previous state, including inventory, experience, health, and hunger.

## ✅ Features

- Open-world **1v1 duels**
- Open-world **2v2 team duels**
- No arena setup required
- No duel zones
- Prevents interference from other players
- Inventory protection and restoration
- Restores XP, health, and hunger after the duel
- Configurable settings
- Multiple language support
- Lightweight and performance-friendly

## 📋 Commands

- `/pvp <player>` — Challenge a player to a 1v1 duel
- `/pvp 2v2 <you> <member> <player1> <player2>` — Challenge two players to a 2v2 duel
- `/pvp toggle` — Enable or disable open-world PvP

## 💡 Why?

FightBorder brings the convenience of traditional duel plugins to the open world. Players can instantly start fair 1v1 or 2v2 battles anywhere on the server without needing dedicated arenas, while still keeping inventories and player progress protected.
